# Data Storytelling Skill for Muse

Turn raw data into stories that make people decide: a three-act structure (Setup → Conflict → Resolution) with a full narrative arc — hook, context, build-up, climax as the key insight, recommendations, call to action. It teaches the three pillars (data = proof, story = meaning, visuals = clarity) with concrete do's and don'ts for presenting analyses to executives, preparing quarterly reviews, investor decks, or data-driven reports.
